title: Learning-Augmented QUBO for Time-Expanded Multi-Commodity Flow
abstract: arXiv:2611.29711v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study energy-aware multi-commodity flow on time-expanded graphs, a problem that captures dynamic routing in layered networks and is NP-hard in general. We formulate the problem as a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization problem, give an explicit penalty coefficient that provably guarantees feasibility, and show that it is smaller than the standard bound by a factor of roughly the number of active links. The layered structure of the time-expanded graph yields three structural results: a treewidth bound that gives a fixed-parameter tractable exact algorithm in the bag size, a matrix-product-operator representation of small bond dimension, and a proof that the annealing gap of the associated Ising Hamiltonian is strictly positive for every instance with a unique optimum, uniformly over bounded windows. translated_title: 面向时间扩展多商品流的学习增强QUBO
translated_abstract: 我们研究时间扩展图上的能量感知多商品流问题，该问题刻画了分层网络中的动态路由，且在一般情况下是NP难的。我们将该问题形式化为二次无约束二进制优化（QUBO）问题，给出了一个可证明地保证可行性的显式惩罚系数，并证明该系数比标准界小大约相当于活跃链路数量的倍数。时间扩展图的分层结构带来了三个结构性结果：一个树宽界，由此得到以袋大小为参数的固定参数可解精确算法；一个小键维度的矩阵乘积算子表示；以及一个证明，即对于每一个具有唯一最优解的实例，相关Ising哈密顿量的退火间隙严格为正，并在有界窗口上一致成立。对于学习增强路由，我们用流误差来界定预测流与最优流之间的汉明距离，并证明……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 该论文将NP难的能量感知多商品流问题转化为QUBO形式并给出比标准界更小的显式惩罚系数，同时利用时间扩展图的分层结构证明了树宽界、低键维矩阵乘积算子表示以及严格为正的退火间隙，为精确算法和量子退火求解提供了理论保证。
en_tdlr: The paper reformulates the NP-hard energy-aware multi-commodity flow on time-expanded graphs as a QUBO with a provably smaller explicit penalty coefficient, and derives structural results—treewidth bounds, low bond-dimension matrix-product-operator representations, and strictly positive annealing gaps—that provide guarantees for exact algorithms and quantum annealing.
